tasks.title: Bump shared constant to v2
tasks.intent: Change packages/shared/meta.mjs from `export const API = "v1";` to `export const API = "v2";`. Nothing else in this task.

tasks.title: Make packages/a apiName derive from the shared constant
tasks.intent: Replace the hardcoded `return "api-v1";` in packages/a/index.mjs with `import { API } from "../shared/meta.mjs";` and `return \`api-${API}\`;` so package a tracks the shared version and returns "api-v2" after T001. T002 and T003 write disjoint files.

tasks.title: Make packages/b apiName derive from the shared constant
tasks.intent: Same change in packages/b/index.mjs: import API from ../shared/meta.mjs and return `api-${API}`, replacing the hardcoded "api-v1".

tasks.title: Update tests to api-v2
tasks.intent: Update tests/api.test.mjs expectations from "api-v1" to "api-v2" for both packages. The old expectations pin the superseded v1 behavior, so the MONO-001-A suite run can only be green after this task.

tasks.title: Run suite for MONO-001-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0, executing the updated tests that pin both apiName()s at "api-v2" sourced from the shared constant.

observations.statement: packages/a and packages/b hardcode "api-v1" instead of reading packages/shared/meta.mjs, which is why the version drifted; deriving apiName() from the shared constant fixes the root cause while satisfying MONO-001.
tests/api.test.mjs asserts the old "api-v1" values; MONO-001 supersedes that behavior, so the test expectations must be updated (T004) before the acceptance command can pass.
